data.long_meaning: The name Claybourne is derived from the Old English words 'claeg' meaning clay and 'burh' meaning fort or town. This name evokes images of a strong, protective community built near a clear, flowing river. The name Claybourne carries the meaning “Clear stream” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Claybourne usually hope their child will grow to embody clear stream and live with faith, good character and purpose.
